title: Coral Atoll Outpost
setting: A floating research station anchored above a year-old coral fragment transplant. The original polyps have died back; a new generation is building on the calcium skeleton left behind, and the crew has to decide whether to seed an even faster-growing strain. The grant runs out in 90 days. The reef doesn't know that.

characters.name: Surveyor
characters.tendencies: Counts growth rings and bleaching events. Double-entry by polyp. Names every individual.
characters.keywords: ring+0.5 bleached+0.5 polyp+0.4 species+0.4 lineage+0.4 grant-0.2

characters.name: Engineer
characters.tendencies: Manages pumps, filtration, predator nets. Distrusts biology that doesn't fit the spec.
characters.keywords: pump+0.5 spec+0.4 net+0.4 rust+0.4 strain+0.4 grant-0.3

characters.name: Translator
characters.tendencies: Writes weekly briefings for the funder collective. Reads the reef's mood.
characters.keywords: briefing+0.5 funder+0.5 mood+0.4 colony+0.5 voice+0.5 grant-0.3

characters.name: Grouper
characters.tendencies: A juvenile that has started following the dive ladder. Trusts the colony, not the crew. Has a name the crew gave it.
characters.keywords: larder+0.5 ladder+0.5 colony+0.5 trust+0.4 name+0.4 crew-0.3
